acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The trailing edge of the visible caudal fin lobe exhibits significant jagged irregularities and a prominent notch near the distal inferior tip, indicative of historical physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: The caudal fin surface contains a sparse distribution of high-luminance circular blobs (approximately 12-15 discrete points) primarily clustered in the mid-to-upper region of the visible lobe.
